info.title: Tourlast Sales Hub API
info.description: REST API for the Tourlast Sales Hub. A request needs the token scope listed on the operation AND the token owner's permission in the Hub. The tourlast.com feed endpoints instead authenticate with the one shared sync token (php artisan hub:generate-token) — each operation says which it wants. Full guide: docs/API.md.

post.summary: Send flight bookings from Flights Super Admin: {"booking": {...}} or {"bookings": [...]} (max 500)
post.description:
Each booking uses the shape documented on App\Integrations\Flights\FlightRecord; external_id, booked_at and booking_status are required. Sending a booking again updates it (older updated_at values are ignored).

**Scope:** `flights:push`

post.summary: POST /integrations/tourlast/providers - {"provider": {...}} or {"providers": [...]} (max 100)
post.description:
Auth: the shared sync token from php artisan hub:generate-token, no user account. Each record goes through the same credit rules as the scheduled sync. A record with is_deleted=true archives the property and its linked lead and registry record (result "deleted"); is_deleted=false restores them.

**Shared token:** the one sync secret from `php artisan hub:generate-token` (no user, role or scope).

bearerAuth.description: Sanctum token from POST /auth/tokens or Admin → API tokens. Scopes: profile, leads:read, leads:write, schedule:read, schedule:write, registry:read, registry:write, onboardings:read, onboardings:write, incentives:read, incentives:write, claims:read, claims:write, team:read, team:write, notifications:read, notifications:write, reports:read, integration:read, integration:push, travel:read, travel:write, flights:push. The tourlast.com feed endpoints take the shared sync token instead (php artisan hub:generate-token).

Forbidden.description: Token lacks the scope, or the person may not do this
